raw_response:
1. SELECT a.asset_name, a.status  
   FROM assets a  
   JOIN asset_types at ON a.asset_type_id = at.asset_type_id  
   WHERE at.type_name = 'Capacitor'  
   ORDER BY a.asset_name;

2. SELECT a.asset_name, a.status  
   FROM assets a  
   JOIN asset_types at ON a.asset_type_id = at.asset_type_id  
   JOIN locations l ON a.location_id = l.location_id  
   WHERE at.type_name = 'Capacitor'  
   ORDER BY a.status, a.asset_name;

3. SELECT a.asset_name, a.status  
   FROM assets a  
   JOIN asset_types at ON a.asset_type_id = at.asset_type_id  
   LEFT JOIN sensor_readings sr ON a.asset_id = sr.asset_id  
   WHERE at.type_name = 'Capacitor'  
   GROUP BY a.asset_id, a.asset_name, a.status  
   ORDER BY a.asset_name;
